# `function-length`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: disciplined · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: `max-lines`

Reports a function spanning more source lines than the configured limit.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

A hard size limit forces a decomposition decision while the whole function can
still be reviewed in one reading.

## When it fires

Blank lines and comments count because readers scroll past them too. A function
returning `type` is not measured as a whole: its body is the container it
returns, whose functions are measured one by one. Like the other
disciplined-profile rules it skips `test` blocks, private functions only tests
call, and test, fuzz, and script files.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Options

Set these in the rule's object in `zig-analyzer.json`, next to `level`:

```json
{
  "lints": {
    "rules": {
      "function-length": {
        "level": "warning",
        "max-lines": 70
      }
    }
  }
}
```

- `max-lines` (default `70`): the longest allowed function in source lines, a
  positive integer.
